an6.46:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā mahācundo cetīsu viharati sahajātiyaṃ.
an6.46:1.3: tatra kho āyasmā mahācundo bhikkhū āmantesi:
an6.46:1.5: “āvuso”ti kho te bhikkhu āyasmato mahācundassa paccassosuṃ.
an6.46:2.2: ime pana “jhāyinomhā jhāyinombhā’ti jhāyanti, pajjhāyanti, kiṃ hime
an6.46:2.3: jhāyanti, kintime jhāyanti, kathaṃ hime jhāyantī”ti.
an6.46:2.4: tattha dhammayogā ca bhikkhū nappasīdanti, jhāyī ca bhikkhū nappasīdanti, na ca bahujanahitāya paṭipannā honti bahujanasukhāya bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ. (2)
an6.46:3.1: idha panāvuso jhāyī bhikkhū dhammayoge bhikkhu apasādenti:
an6.46:3.2: ime pana “dhammayogamhā dhammayogamhā”ti uddhatā unnalā capalā mukharā vikiṇṇavācā muṭṭhassatī asampajānā asamāhitā vibbhantacittā pākatindriyā.
an6.46:3.3: kiṃ hime dhammayogā, kintime dhammeyogā, kathaṃ hime dhammayogāti?
an6.46:3.4: tattha jhāyī ca bhikkhū nappasīdanti, dhammayogā ca bhikkhū nappasīdanti, na ca bahujanahitāya paṭipannā honti bahujanasukhāya, bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ. (3)
an6.46:4.1: idha panāvuso dhammayogā bhikkhū dhammayogānaṃyeva bhikkhūnaṃ vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti, no jhāyīnaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti.
an6.46:4.2: tattha dhammayogā ca bhikkhū nappasīdanti, jhāyī ca bhikkhū nappasīdanti, na ca bahujanahitāya paṭipannā honti bahujanasukhāya, bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ. (4)
an6.46:5.1: idha panāvuso jhāyī bhikkhū jhāyīnaṃ yeva bhikkhūnaṃ vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti no dhammayogānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti.
an6.46:5.2: tattha jhāyī ca bhikkhū nappasīdanti, dhammayogā ca bhikkhū nappasīdanti, na ca bahujanahitāya paṭipaṭipannā honti bahujanasukhāya, bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ. (5)
an6.46:6.2: dhammayogā samānā jhāyīnaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vaṇṇaṃ bhāsissāmāti.
an6.46:6.5: acchariyā hete āvuso puggalā dullabhā lokasmiṃ, ye amataṃ dhātuṃ kāyena phusitvā viharanti. (6)
an6.46:7.2: jhāyī samānā dhammayogānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vaṇṇaṃ bhāsissāmāti.
an6.46:7.5: acchariyā hete āvuso puggalā dullabhā lokasmiṃ, ye gambhīraṃ atthapadaṃ paññāya ativijjha passantīti.
